mixed_findings.Q01: Logged-action auxiliary and integrated OOF R-loss both enlarge the explicit response, but neither establishes that removal of the old structure penalty was the primary collapse cause or makes the terminal response path dominant.
mixed_findings.Q15: Early signed effects and the best action alignment move across folds; lead behavior and closed-loop conditioning do not isolate timing, feedback confounding, and genuine fast response.
mixed_findings.Q19: Context/activity regressions are descriptive and fold-disjoint, but they do not uniquely explain the observed side/fold gain exchange.

principal_findings.terminal_bypass: P5 no-bypass worsens terminal MAE by 0.2027 C on average, while bypass-only preserves terminal MAE within +0.0048 C; the P5 terminal advantage is therefore bypass-dominated, not a verified end-to-end physical chain.
principal_findings.explicit_response: Training response-off changes P5 terminal MAE by only +0.0060 C at 4000 updates; at 8000 updates the response path becomes more material but remains secondary to bypass.
principal_findings.action_shield: Action shielding raises H60 response magnitude by 0.1074 C and restores wrong-side/lead sensitivity in both folds, while worsening terminal MAE by 0.0152 C and local MAE by 0.0621 C.
principal_findings.valve_decoder: Predicted mean |delta valve| remains about 0.05-0.09 point versus 0.31-0.32 observed. Structured PI alone collapses dynamics and is rejected; PI+GRU and delta/roughness remain engineering candidates with prediction trade-offs.
principal_findings.mimo: Residualized valve innovations have effective rank 2 with differential energy fractions 0.238 and 0.368, but diagonal/common/full response coordinates have nearly identical forecast MAE. Independent excitation is numerically present; full cross-gain superiority is not supported.
principal_findings.response_shape: Blocked OOS shape RMSE differs by less than about 0.001 C across linear, power, one/two/three-pole and bounded-dead-time families, with wins dispersed; no physical order or dead time is identified.
principal_findings.optimization: All three 8000-update anchors improve terminal MAE by 0.0346-0.0414 C over their 4000-update counterparts; the old 4000-update comparison mixed architecture with optimization budget.
principal_findings.rollout: C31 recursive second-window terminal/local/valve/Tin skill versus persistence is -0.034/-0.303/-0.326/-0.150 in F0; 30-60 minute simulation remains unavailable and the model is not state closed.

rm3b_input_manifest.composition_rule: Do not stack every eligible component. Freeze paired compositions against C28/C29/C30 and require same-direction evidence in both folds before multi-seed confirmation.
